question: In a certain code language, ‘ACQUIRE’ is written as 'QCAUERI’, 'ADDRESS' is written as 'DDARSSE’, and ‘ABILITY’ is written as 'IBALYTI'. How will ICEBERG’ be written in that language?
solution:
**Explanation:**

According to the English alphabet and their positional values:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

First and third alphabets are interchanged & fifth and seventh alphabets are interchanged.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/088a01ab724f9fb2c39180f13db5c9d9a1c4b1cf893a8738fcf4527d030fcbeb.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7db511ae13c512fd5ffb065795892b9f0a40b3e96445e48d7136a3e60a3eab3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/780898ae8a58c28829d01aaa5d991ea6a73881e6dfc6caf7b7d04e27dcdd2504.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e74cabeda6c440d9737fa8ce6055a95a7d5e65cfc7054d90e546b759b6c0a907.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 3.**
